chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在岸上/上岸(相对于在船上、在海上)。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors were glad to step on shore after the long trip.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们在漫长航行后很高兴踏上岸。

chunks.head: at length
chunks.note: at length = 经过一段时间后终于(表时间的转折)。
chunks.ex_en: At length the bus arrived, and we all got on.
chunks.ex_cn: 终于,公交车来了,我们都上了车。

chunks.head: in pieces
chunks.note: break/fall in pieces = 破碎成小块。
chunks.ex_en: The old cup fell and broke in pieces.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只旧杯子掉下来摔成了碎片。

chunks.head: find out
chunks.note: find out = 通过寻找/打听而发现、弄清楚。
chunks.ex_en: Let's find out who left the door open.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们来查清是谁把门开着的。

chunks.head: good for nothing
chunks.note: good for nothing = 派不上任何用场。
chunks.ex_en: This broken pen is good for nothing now.
chunks.ex_cn: 这支坏了的笔现在毫无用处。

chunks.head: make use of
chunks.note: make use of sth = 加以利用某物。
chunks.ex_en: We should make use of the free time to study.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们应该利用空闲时间学习。

chunks.head: stand still
chunks.note: stand still = 停下不动;work stood still = 工作停滞。
chunks.ex_en: Please stand still while I take the photo.
chunks.ex_cn: 我拍照时请站着别动。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 大量的。
chunks.ex_en: She spent a great deal of money on books.
chunks.ex_cn: 她花了大量的钱买书。

chunks.head: go to work
chunks.note: go to work (on/with sth) = 开始动手做某事。
chunks.ex_en: After breakfast he went to work on the garden.
chunks.ex_cn: 早饭后他动手打理花园。

chunks.head: on board
chunks.note: on board = 在船（车、飞机）上；get on board = 登船。
chunks.ex_en: Everyone was on board before the ship left.
chunks.ex_cn: 船离开前每个人都上了船。

chunks.head: for fear of
chunks.note: for fear of + 名词/动名词 = 因为担心…而(不)做。
chunks.ex_en: He walked slowly for fear of falling.
chunks.ex_cn: 他走得很慢,生怕摔倒。

chunks.head: take courage
chunks.note: take courage = 打起精神、鼓起勇气。
chunks.ex_en: Take courage; the test is not so hard.
chunks.ex_cn: 鼓起勇气,考试没那么难。

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: lay up = 把东西储存起来备用。
chunks.ex_en: The ants lay up food for the winter.
chunks.ex_cn: 蚂蚁为冬天储存食物。

chunks.head: put in order
chunks.note: put sth in order = 把某物整理妥当。
chunks.ex_en: She put her desk in order before class.
chunks.ex_cn: 她在上课前把书桌整理好。

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在这段时间里(表两事之间)。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is at seven; in the meantime, let's play a game.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭七点开;与此同时,我们玩个游戏吧。

chunks.head: occur to
chunks.note: it occurs to sb that… = 某人突然想到…。

literal.note_cn: (此处)(念头)浮现于脑海,非'发生'义

chunks.ex_en: It did not occur to me to lock the door.
chunks.ex_cn: 我没想到要锁门。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(gave it over / gave that also over),故 card-only。give over = 停止做某事。
chunks.ex_en: He finally gave over trying to fix the old radio.
chunks.ex_cn: 他最终放弃了修那台旧收音机。

chunks.head: take care of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(took such care of it),故 card-only。take care of = 照看、料理。
chunks.ex_en: Please take care of my dog while I am away.
chunks.ex_cn: 我不在时请照看我的狗。

chunks.head: hunt down
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(hunt them down),故 card-only。hunt down = 一直追到抓住为止。
chunks.ex_en: The police worked hard to hunt down the thief.
chunks.ex_cn: 警方努力追捕那个小偷。

chunks.head: at a loss
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(at a great loss),故 card-only。at a loss = 茫然、没了主意。

literal.note_cn: (此处)'不知所措'的状态,非'损失'义

chunks.ex_en: When she asked me, I was at a loss for words.
chunks.ex_cn: 她问我时,我一时语塞。

chunks.head: take notice of
chunks.note: 本章出处未连续出现(take notice how / taking no notice),故 card-only。take notice of = 加以注意。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher took notice of the quiet boy.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师注意到了那个安静的男孩。
